title: PARTNER SHIP STAYS AFTER HOST EXTRACTION
why: The both-out host branch erased the shared ship while player 2 was still playing. Keep the called ship on its existing clock and clear only the host pull. Playtest watch: in smooth look, have player 2 call a ship, board as player 1 first, then board as player 2 without calling again; the run should end only after both are out. Solo extraction should still end at once.
now: When player 1 extracts first, the called ship stays for player 2 until its boarding window closes.
